title: Extraction architecture implementation & blind pre-certification
objective: Implement the asymmetric hybrid role extraction architecture (Layers 1-5), commit and lock the independent evaluator, assemble and freeze the blind validation corpus (>=50 roles, 15-20 resumes) and human reference truth, pre-register thresholds, and execute single-pass blind validation scoring (Steps 1-5). Step 6 shadow mode deployment remains a deliberate checkpoint requiring governance approval.
mustNotChange: deterministic Extraction V1 semantics or frozen-baseline behavior until certified
production extraction authority remains the existing deterministic baseline until Batch 06 production certification
no live shadow-mode execution or scraper mutation until Steps 1-5 are completed and approved
evaluation, policy, verdict, canonical persistence, dossier, serving, UI, or Batch 01 source/provenance immutability behavior
requiredVerification: commit and SHA-256 lock production evaluator in Step 1
implement HighRiskSemanticVerifier and StructuralAdmissionEngine in Step 2
assemble, dual-review, and hash lock blind reference truth in Step 3
pre-register thresholds and consequence table in Step 4
execute single-pass blind validation and baseline dual-run in Step 5
npx tsc -p tsconfig.verify.json --noEmit after each implementation commit
per-commit acknowledgement in IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json for governed changes
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
completionEvidence: Step 2 verifier and structural admission implementation
Step 3 blind population and reference truth hash freeze
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly.
